attributes.action: Force schools to close if they are over a certain temperature
attributes.background: If in a school classroom; the temperature exceeds 32°c they should be forced to close for the safety of the students. The room will be too hot for students to study and it can become a major health hazard as most schools have the shortest break times legally possible.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

Legislate a statutory maximum temperature for classrooms and fund school cooling
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/774023
